scope: Retrospective research protocol frozen before any numerical proxy output or forecast evaluation; not preregistered before the exposed 2020-2024 historical panel

primary.price_basis: Constant 2011-12 prices, GDP at market prices, INR crore
primary.seasonal_model: OLS log GDP on intercept, linear integer quarter index, and zero-sum four-quarter effects; fitted on available prefix only
primary.trend_filter: Endpoint of HP solution (I + lambda D2' D2) trend = seasonally adjusted log GDP; recompute for each dated available prefix
primary.reported_units: Percent deviation of seasonally adjusted GDP from statistical log trend: 100*expm1(log_cycle)
primary.additional_units: 100*log_cycle in log percentage points, reported separately
primary.history_window: All available consecutive quarters; no forecasts or future observations appended

availability.strict_historical_condition: Documented availability tied to retained table bytes/version with source-linked publication/link evidence, earlier than exclusive cutoff; coherent vector from one source vintage
unaccepted_proxies: later final-vintage values assigned to earlier cutoffs
source URL existence at current retrieval alone
availability.missingness: Return no strict historical observation when version availability/coherence or required history is unverified; preserve numerical ex-post diagnostics separately
availability.composition: No silent splicing. Multi-source vectors are excluded from primary version1; a later protocol would require a frozen audited precedence/revision contract.
availability.publication_bound: If version linkage is documented but exact first release time is unknown, a genuine conservative upper bound may be recorded explicitly as a bound, not fabricated exact first timestamp.

sensitivities.pre_covid_reason: Nonrepeating COVID movements can be absorbed by constant quarter dummy refits; fixed pre-COVID seasonality is a separate assumption, not an official correction

diagnostics.endpoint_news: Within each retained downloaded source vector compare prefix endpoint with later extended filter estimate of that same reference quarter; explicitly pseudo-real-time/ex-post, never substitute into earlier information set
diagnostics.data_revision: Compare the same reference endpoint and same prefix length across retained versions; current downloads do not authenticate historical availability
diagnostics.uncertainty: Sensitivity ranges and revisions are not calibrated confidence intervals or fitted model uncertainty

assumptions: Statistical detrending proxy, not measured potential output or structural capacity
Constant proportional quarter seasonality, no moving holiday/calendar treatment
28 quarters is a conservative study choice informed by IMF/Eurostat seasonal guidance, not an HP identification theorem
No parameter/source selection based on Taylor/comparator forecast scores
Economic forecasting usefulness and Indian seasonal adequacy remain unverified
